about: An ember shot made to be tinted (haloEmber, seamEmber, veilEmber, wraithEmber, whirlEmber, ricochetEmber, tortoiseEmber, chainEmber: each creature's own colour of fire). White-hot, so the tint is the colour; the orange fireball stays for plain embers.
name: Ember

ember.png.prompt: Paint a single round ember of white-hot fire: a bright white glowing core wrapped in flickering pale flame, a few tiny sparks and a short wispy flame tail curling to the left. Pure light and fire, nothing solid. Plain flat pure black background (#000000), no floor, no scenery, centered with plenty of empty black space around it. Dark fantasy video game effect art, painterly, glowing.
